name: same
description: SAME/EAS alert headers on NOAA weather radio, AFSK at 520.83 baud

fields.name: org
fields.description: originator: EAS, WXR, CIV or PEP

fields.name: event
fields.description: three-letter SAME event code, e.g. TOR, RWT

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: human name for the event code

fields.name: fips
fields.description: affected counties as five-digit FIPS codes, comma-separated

fields.name: fips_raw
fields.description: location codes as the raw six-digit PSSCCC, comma-separated

fields.name: callsign
fields.description: the sending station's id, same as device_id

fields.name: purge
fields.description: how long the alert is valid, HHMM

fields.name: issued
fields.description: issue time as day-of-year and UTC time, JJJHHMM
